prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable full-screen background texture for SANAD web and mobile UI, portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, at least 1024×1536
Input images: Image 1 is the approved UI comp; use only its warm porcelain background and the character, softness, scale, and upper-right placement of its mashrabiya daylight shadow as visual reference. Do not reproduce or rasterize any UI from the reference.
Primary request: Create a seamless-feeling, freely croppable soft mashrabiya daylight shadow field on a warm off-white porcelain ground. A sparse geometric Islamic lattice shadow enters from beyond the upper-right edge and drifts diagonally into roughly the upper quarter to upper third of the portrait canvas, becoming progressively lighter and disappearing into clean negative space. The geometry should feel projected by daylight through a real wooden screen, with gentle irregularity, softened overlapping edges, and subtle natural tonal variation—not a crisp vector pattern.
Scene/backdrop: empty warm off-white ground only, visually close to #FDFCF9 and #FDFBF8.
Subject: light and shadow only; no physical lattice, no room, no architecture, no objects.
Style/medium: refined natural-light photography / high-end material study, softly defocused, quiet, airy, understated, production-ready background asset.
Composition/framing: edge-to-edge portrait 2:3; strongest shadow cropped at the upper-right corner; lighter fragments may extend toward the upper center and right edge; lower two-thirds remain predominantly clean warm off-white so semantic UI can sit above it; no focal object; croppable at web and phone aspect ratios; no visible seams or hard frame boundaries.
Lighting/mood: diffused late-morning daylight, soft low-contrast gray-beige shadows with a faint warm lavender cast, calm and dignified.
Color palette: #FDFCF9, #FDFBF8, translucent warm taupe-gray, whisper of #E8D8FF only in the softest shadow transitions.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no Arabic calligraphy, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no people, no furniture, no plants, no invoice, no icons, no controls, no cards, no interface, no counterseal, no financial content, no border, no vignette, no strong contrast, no saturated color, no repeated wallpaper effect, no sharp vector-like geometry. Output only the standalone background texture.
